summary: Completed comprehensive testing of notification categories, RBAC, and light mode UI improvements. All backend APIs (32/32 tests) and frontend features working correctly. Light mode is default with solid white card backgrounds for good contrast. Notification bell shows compact view with category chips, detail popup has all 11 category filters, and admin config matrix (29 roles × 11 categories) is functional. RBAC correctly enforced: HR user has access only to HR, My Portal, and Collaboration portals.
